g.text: Trusted LAN only: authenticated MQTT is not encrypted.
PostgreSQL stays loopback-only; no Pi-to-database connection.
QoS 1 PUBACK means broker acceptance, not database success.
No durable forwarding queue or offline replay; outages can lose readings.
After restarting an input broker, explicitly restart its Spin listener.
Host-side credential/broker helpers remain under pwerusage/deploy.
